about.summary: College of the Siskiyous (COS) is a public community college with campuses in Weed and Yreka in Siskiyou County in Northern California. It is part of the California Community Colleges System, serving as the northernmost college in the state of California and the only college in Siskiyou County. The college is in the service area of California State University, Chico and one of only eleven community colleges in California that provide on-campus housing for students.

It includes contact information for the office and general information about the college's policies.

documents.title: Strategic and Master Plans of the College of the Siskiyous
documents.summary: College of the Siskiyous integrates Planning, Assessment, and Budgeting into a cohesive six-year system, emphasizing collegial dialogue and effectiveness. The Strategic and Master Plans, including the Strategic Enrollment Management Plan (2023-2028) and Technology Master Plan (2021-2025), navigate through a participatory governance process before Board Approval. The Plans prioritize institutional goals aligned with the Mission and Vision, utilizing tools such as measurement and analysis for continuous improvement.
